# Aurelia Freight Analytics — Company Profile

## Overview

Aurelia Freight Analytics, Inc. is a logistics-software company founded in 2016 in Rotterdam, Netherlands, by Mireille Vandaele and Tomasz Kowalczyk. The company sells route-optimization and freight-visibility software to mid-sized carriers and shippers in Europe and North America. Headquarters moved from Rotterdam to Amsterdam in 2021. As of the end of fiscal year 2024 the company had 412 employees across offices in Amsterdam, Warsaw and Chicago.

## Leadership

- Mireille Vandaele — Chief Executive Officer (co-founder)
- Tomasz Kowalczyk — Chief Technology Officer (co-founder)
- Priya Raman — Chief Financial Officer; joined in March 2022 from a European payments company
- Daniel Okafor — Chief Revenue Officer; joined in January 2024 to lead the North American expansion

## Financial highlights

The fiscal year ends on 31 December.

The Enterprise tier of every product includes single sign-on (SSO) and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

## Customers and markets

Aurelia serves more than 1,150 customers. Its largest segment is regional carriers operating 50 to 500 trucks, which account for about 63% of revenue. North America contributed 31% of FY2024 revenue, up from 22% in FY2023. No single customer accounts for more than 3% of revenue.

## Key risks

Management identifies three principal risks: a prolonged freight recession that reduces carrier technology budgets; competition from established transportation management system (TMS) incumbents adding native optimization features; and tightening EU data-residency requirements that could raise hosting costs.

## Sustainability

Aurelia has committed to net-zero operations by 2030. All offices have run on 100% renewable electricity since 2022.

Total equity funding raised to date is €147M.

## Products

**RouteForge** is the company's original product: a route-optimization engine that plans multi-stop routes and reduces empty miles. Customers report an average 11% reduction in fuel costs in their first year. RouteForge pricing starts at €29 per vehicle per month.

**TraceLine** provides real-time freight visibility. It ingests position data from more than 40 ELD and telematics providers and exposes shipments through a REST API and webhooks.

**DockSync** is a dock appointment scheduling product launched in 2023. It lets shippers publish loading-dock availability and lets carriers book time slots, reducing detention time at warehouses.

The Enterprise tier of every product includes single sign-on (SSO) and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

## Error codes

- **TL-1001** — Invalid or expired access token. Request a new token and retry.
- **TL-1042** — Device not paired. The ELD or telematics device ID has not been linked to a vehicle. Pair it under Settings > Devices.
- **TL-2210** — Geofence overlap. Two geofences for the same facility overlap by more than 15%. Merge or resize them.
- **TL-3307** — Telematics feed stale. No position update has been received for more than 30 minutes. Check the device's connectivity and power.
- **TL-4500** — Internal error. Contact support and include the request ID from the response.

## Data retention and residency

Position history is retained for 13 months on the Standard plan and 36 months on the Enterprise plan. Data for EU customers is stored exclusively in the Frankfurt (eu-central) region.

## Support tiers

# TraceLine Integration & Support Guide

## API basics

The TraceLine API base URL is `https://api.traceline.example/v2`. Authentication uses the OAuth2 client-credentials flow. Access tokens expire after 3600 seconds and must be refreshed by requesting a new token.

### Rate limits

Each API key is limited to 600 requests per minute on the Standard plan and 3,000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Requests beyond the limit receive HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header indicating how many seconds to wait.

### Webhooks

TraceLine can push the events `shipment.created`, `shipment.delayed` and `shipment.delivered` to a customer endpoint. Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times with exponential backoff over roughly 24 hours. Every webhook is signed with HMAC-SHA256; the signature is sent in the `X-TraceLine-Signature` header and should be verified with the shared webhook secret.

## API basics

The TraceLine API base URL is `https://api.traceline.example/v2`. Authentication uses the OAuth2 client-credentials flow. Access tokens expire after 3600 seconds and must be refreshed by requesting a new token.

### Rate limits

Each API key is limited to 600 requests per minute on the Standard plan and 3,000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Requests beyond the limit receive HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header indicating how many seconds to wait.

### Webhooks

TraceLine can push the events `shipment.created`, `shipment.delayed` and `shipment.delivered` to a customer endpoint. Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times with exponential backoff over roughly 24 hours. Every webhook is signed with HMAC-SHA256; the signature is sent in the `X-TraceLine-Signature` header and should be verified with the shared webhook secret.

## Error codes

## Error codes

- **TL-1001** — Invalid or expired access token. Request a new token and retry.
- **TL-1042** — Device not paired. The ELD or telematics device ID has not been linked to a vehicle. Pair it under Settings > Devices.
- **TL-2210** — Geofence overlap. Two geofences for the same facility overlap by more than 15%. Merge or resize them.
- **TL-3307** — Telematics feed stale. No position update has been received for more than 30 minutes. Check the device's connectivity and power.
- **TL-4500** — Internal error. Contact support and include the request ID from the response.

## Data retention and residency

Position history is retained for 13 months on the Standard plan and 36 months on the Enterprise plan. Data for EU customers is stored exclusively in the Frankfurt (eu-central) region.

Total equity funding raised to date is €147M.

## Products

Total equity funding raised to date is €147M.

## Products

**RouteForge** is the company's original product: a route-optimization engine that plans multi-stop routes and reduces empty miles. Customers report an average 11% reduction in fuel costs in their first year. RouteForge pricing starts at €29 per vehicle per month.

**TraceLine** provides real-time freight visibility. It ingests position data from more than 40 ELD and telematics providers and exposes shipments through a REST API and webhooks.

**DockSync** is a dock appointment scheduling product launched in 2023. It lets shippers publish loading-dock availability and lets carriers book time slots, reducing detention time at warehouses.

The Enterprise tier of every product includes single sign-on (SSO) and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
